text: Doesn’t work on iPad. This app works well on a phone, but it is always sideways on an iPad. (It’s not locked.) I think it needs an update to match the iOS update but until then, it’s useless.
Wearing this a lot!. Super cute, feels great! Will wear it often. With the gold buttons can dress it up or keep casual
Love them!. Fits well and so comfy
Soft and elegant. Soft buttery but not yellow color and fabric. So cute but elegant, dress it up or down.
Love!. This is a perfect transitional dress for seasons. It is roomy and comfy!
Adorable. I love it so much I bought it. It runs really big so size down. It’s a bulky look but super cute!! So many compliments!
Love this top. SO many compliments!
Great sweater. This is my second time renting the sweater and I loved it so much that I’ve had to purchase it.
Perfect fall dress. So flattering and easy! It was a must!

Sizing filter needs fixing. Love everything about the app and clothes, but searching based on your sizes is only offered as numerical sizes - but most clothes are offered as XS/S/M/L/XL and so even if filtered, it’ll show you all clothes available but it’ll then only have XS or XL available. Could be easy fix and would make the searching much easier

So chic. Postpartum safe haven. I was looking to spruce up my wardrobe and find pieces I feel good wearing while I’m getting back to pre-baby weight. This felt so beautiful on and just a further testament as to why I LOVE NUULY. I find quality pieces that get delivered to my home that make me excited for fashion again. As a mom of two under 4, this is huge.

All convenience. I just love how much time this saves me shopping online because of the recommendations and also dry cleaning things so that they look new. The only downside is you don’t know the quality of the item or how many times it’s been worn before you receive it

Love love love Nuuly. Nuuly was a game changer in style for me. I tried other company’s and didn’t like the style at picking things out and more expensive. I have been using Nuuly for a year now and it’s the best. I get so many compliments on my cloths on clothes I would never be able to afford. Then when I’m Bored with them I send them back. If ever an issue customer service is always there to help.

Best clothing rental options. Newly had helped me through my maternity journey and as my weight fluctuates. I love that I don’t have to buy things and I’m a little more daring when I make choices because of it. If I fall in love with an item I like being able to buy after I try it out for a month. I wish there was a better system for when you don’t like something or it doesn’t fit but overall I have had a great experience and been a member for years.
The denim shirt of your dreams. The best fitting denim top! Runs large so size down a size or even 2. It’s soooo cute! Got compliments and ended up keeping :)
Sexy but understated. Perfect for a concert or festival date, brunch with friends, shopping in the city, and not too short. It’s hard to find dresses for women over 50 that are the right length.
Love. A tiny bit big but I think they are supposed to fit baggy. If you want them tight size down one.

Best Dress Ever. I noticed by the other reviews that everyone of every size and shape and age looked good in this dress. It did not disappoint. I am heavier than usual and was super bummed about it and I didn’t feel that way for one second in this dress! So flattering and I’ve never had so many compliments in my whole life!
Love these jeans!. These are so cute easy to style and great fit and color!

Fabulous Skirt!. LOVED it. Bought it. This skirt is such a beautiful color and material. I dressed it up with a black sweater and boots for work, and wore it casual with a jean jacket out. It came new with tags, and in perfect condition!
Comfy and cute color. Wear at work or the beach! So versatile
Love. Just placed another order and I can’t wait for it to arrive!!
Sustainable fashion. Quality clothing rental that allows for sustainable circulation of fashion. New wardrobe accents monthly without the concerns of constant purging. Love it!
Fun new styles. Easy and Just in time for a refresh before my trip.

Literally the best. I never write these but feel compelled - their customer service, process, shipping, returns… every aspect is so easy and I feel so sophisticated with the selections. I can branch out without spending a paycheck on a design choice. I’ve gotten so many compliments on the clothes and I haven’t broken the bank. I don’t need to own every piece of my wardrobe for events. I absolutely love everything about this company, and I refer all my friends!

Great but want to customize the recommendation for maternity. I started using Nully because I was looking for maternity clothing, and it works great for me! However, the app keeps recommending regular clothing that won't fit my baby bump, even after I ordered maternity clothing. Also, the recent update hided the maternity page even deeper in the app, and it is annoying to find. I really want a function where I can set the birthdate so the app recommends to me only clothing that fits me.
Favorite. Loved this airy shirt. Wore it so much I had to have it.
So much fun!. I love ordering vacation outfits from nuuly!
Comfy and cozy. Perfect fall shirt, fits tts
LOVE!. Perfect color, comfortable materials and overall cute with anything.
Love renting clothes. I thought I would not enjoy renting but it’s fabulous!! It’s like a new wardrobe every month !! So many compliments!! Customer service great too !!
No gate keeping here!. Obsessed. Period. I get compliments every time I’m wearing a Nuuly piece! This is the best subscription clothing rental and I recommend it to all my friends!
Love. I’m enjoying Nuuly! It’s nice shopping from your couch with styles that are new and trendsetting!
Perfect in many ways. Such a light weight dress that can be for honestly any occasion! And it has POCKETS!!!
Obsessed. I love love love Nuuly. It is so worth it to me

Nuuly is my GO TO. Love everything about Nuuly. It give that retail therapy fix but for a fraction of the cost. The items that I’ve bought are staples in my closet and the customer service is amazing.
Love these shorts !. They fit true to size & fit perfect . I couldn’t part with them so I didn’t ! Highly recommend!!

Needs to be easier to rent. The app should allow you to favorite your size as well to make renting easier from your favorite page. It’s a lot of scrolling and checking. Also needs more styles and if something is popular we need multiple units in that size. It’s very hard to find a full 6 styles you want.

Service is great but app keeps messing up. This app is constantly bugging out. It doesn’t load. When it does work, you’ll be looking through items, change the category, and it doesn’t load anything again. You have to constant refresh the app, turn off your vpn, and it still won’t work. It’s been like this for months and seems to be getting worse. PLEASE FIX THE BUGS!!!
App is broken rn. Can open, cannot click anything. Deleted app and redownloaded. Restarted phone. Still nothing. Pls fix.

App doesn’t work.. Hasn’t since I started the service in June. Signed up online. Would love to use the phone app. Frozen on opening page. Can’t even scroll or select anything. Even updated iPhone iOS and still not working.

The best. Nuuly is the best. Their customer service is top tier. Shipping is so fast. Have a million clothes options, from athleisure to formal and everything in between. Petite sizes to plus sizes. And it saves the planet! Can’t say enough good things. 10/10 recommend renting front m them!!

App is no longer working. I guess there was an update on the app and now it is no longer working. It is frozen on the first page and doesn’t allow me to scroll or select any options like going to my lists or closets. Just stuck on the main page. I’ll have to try using the website which is much less convenient. Hope this is fixed soon

NO! Better apps for rentals. There are better clothing subscription apps out there. They have a nice selection of clothing options but the app and its general UI SUCKS. App is constantly crashing, terrible interface issues, the overall design feels dated and old. At first the process seems smooth but it is not.
Worth every penny. Fabulous customer service, clean clothes, I love how open everyone is in the reviews (makes figuring out sizing much easier) and so stylish!!!

Not as good as rent the runway. I have been using Nuuly for about a year now. The biggest downfall is that they don’t care for their clothing very well. The cleaner that they use is very potent. I almost always put all of the clothes directly into the washing machine upon reciept. it takes about a week for it to arrive after ordering it. And you need to get it back to them in time. So it’s really not a monthly rental. Rent the runway has the best logistics and this is not even comparable. Nuuly arrives very wrinkled.. And sometimes the clothes are so misshapen or shrunken or damaged. That being said, it is a collection of very good brands. So if you have the patience to iron and wash everything once you get it then it’s fine. But with the shrinkage, it is often that you can’t wear anything that you rented. And their customer service care to help you with that

Great Service, App is Buggy. Not sure what happened with these last couple of updates but the app is SO buggy now! Every minute or so, the four icons at the bottom (home, search, closet, bag) will disappear and I have to close the app if I want to get into my bag or something. Additionally, the screen will lag when I scroll and jump back up several swipes. Super annoying :/ I have a secure wifi connection and have never experienced this prior to the recent updates! But I will say, I love Nuuly so much and will continue to use it despite these bugs! The customer service is wonderful and they have a great selection of items. Also, student discount!

Great but UX needs work. Stunning concept but y’all need a UI designer to figure out your back button situation. I keep getting trapped. And the only way to get to another tab is to X out of the app completely. Plz fix

Navigation. Please fix your iOS app navigation! The background of the tab should have a fill and the navigation always disappears leaving me to have to close the app multiple times a session to navigate the app properly.

Good customer service terrible UX. Great customer service. However, the UX design of this app has significantly decreased in usability, quality, & functionality. Why does the bottom navigation menu keep disappearing? It locks you onto one page. I hopped on for 10 minutes to look through clothes for an upcoming rental and had to close out of the app 3 times.

I love my bnto - app suggestions. I have seen the updates to the app which have really enhanced user experience. I would love to see a “home” button on every screen so I don’t have to click the back button after going 10 items deep. Also a continuous reel of photos so you get back to first photo after swiping past the last one would be nice. My favorite thing when I get a compliment on an item is to say, “it’s from my BNTO🤭” - I think I’ve referred 3 people to try it!

Amazing customer service!. I see a lot of reviews about items being sold out or longer waits for shipping. However, I will say that BNTO really does listen to these reviews. They recently credited my account as an apology for longer shipping times (and I honestly hadn’t even noticed any inconvenience to begin with)! I also had an issue with the delivery carrier of my items and their team made it right within 24 hours of my initial email. Yes, there are a lot of amazing items that are out of stock sometimes. BUT there are also so many other great items added every month. Unlike other subscriptions, I feel like the clothes are in great shape and mine have often come new with tags!

Great styles, but shipping and app UX could improve. I like BNTO’s styles, but shipping can take five days. Compared with competitors offering faster shipping at similar prices, it feels like you’re paying the same for one less week of wear. App feedback: I often scroll through items to add several to my wishlist, but hearting an item opens the capsule drawer and interrupts browsing. Making capsule addition less intrusive would create a much smoother wishlist experience.

I like their clothes but they take sooooo long to ship. I’ve been trying for months with BNTO but I think it’s time to finally give it up. After you place an order it takes 5+ days to arrive. With Nuuly or RTR, the clothes arrive in 2 days or less. It’s hard to justify paying $100 a month when you truly only have the clothes for 3 weeks. Their app is also insanely glitchy and it lacks any of the filtering options that the other clothing rental apps have, so you spend a ton of time scrolling.
By far the best clothing rental brand. Absolutely love BNTO
Nothing is in stock. They have no stock of anything. Seems like it takes months for them to replenish too

Rentals are so cute, app is unreliable. I’m on my first month renting with BNTO and getting ready for my second month. The app hasn’t worked for 2 days this past week. I can’t log in and pick my items.

No hygiene, no stars. My last box arrived smelling musty, with a coat missing a button and a pink shirt so wrinkled it was clearly never dry cleaned — it also had a crusty stain on it. Paying a premium for a clothing rental service means trusting that items are actually cleaned. Mine weren’t. No QA was done, and I cancelled as a result.

Good website bad app. I love this clothing rental company! The rental options are much more my style compared to other rental companies. Only thing is the app isn’t very intuitive and has tons of bugs and keeps crashing.
Love the service but there are bugs. Love BNTO, but the app crashes almost every time I use it. Also, the sort from $ high-low does not work. PLEASE fix! (Especially the crashing)

Best rental. This is def my fav rental app, especially because they have accessories! However the app seems glitchy. I love to filter by newest but it always shows me random things that have been around for months. Which kind of makes it a challenge to see what is actually new.
Poor User Experience. I think the app could definitely use a redesign to mimic the RRT or Nuuly interface. This feels a little clunky.

The BEST Subscription Service. BNTO is quite literally the most valuable clothing subscription service I’ve used. For starters, the designers are all emerging brands that I would otherwise not know about or have little access to. The quality of the product is excellent and the S&R process is easy and quick! I have the first world dilemma of having limited closet space and a deep love for fashion, so BNTO makes it easy for me to try new styles without have to commit or completely max out my bank account and my closet space. I recommend this service to the people I love as well as the internet! I also get soooo many compliments on the pieces I rent. Try BNTO yesterday!!!

FOR THE COOL GIRLS WHO LOVE UNIQUE BRANDS. I’m an avid clothing rental girl. Have been for about 5 years now, and can say BNTO has some of the most unique clothing selection. I never feel like what I am renting is the same as what everyone else has! Pricing is on par and I am always finding new brands that I love from them. Plus the accessories and bags really make it next level! I can’t imagine switching to anything else.

where cool people rent. I've been renting clothes monthly since 2023, so I've really seen it all. I’m glad to have discovered BNTO. I’ve been using BNTO for 7 months and I’m really happy with it. The pieces they carry are truly unique, some are like art, with silhouettes, patterns, and materials that I have not seen anywhere else. The app is easy to use and does a good job featuring new designers. While BNTO does have a drawback keeping things in stock it’s not impossible to order items. I try never to get attached to a singular piece, rather when it’s time to pick my new monthly delivery I filter by whats in stock so there’s no heartbreak. If you're looking to diversify your wardrobe it's a blast! I do wish they had slightly more specific filters, like filtering by Warm/Cold Weather or by Occasion. But I think these things will come in time since they're still newer. ❤️

Inconsistent UI. I would say that it’s easy to find brands for the most part when you search things it’s not really consistent. There should be better options for keywords and I haven’t been able to search certain terms that helped me find the right product. There aren’t a lot of categories either when you look on the homepage, the side panel is pretty good and has the most recent items. But there should be better filters overall.

Best Clothing Rental. I’ve tried a few different clothing rental companies and BNTO has been my favorite! They offer accessories as part of your rental which is so much fun to be able to add statement jewelry & belts. BNTO also has a great customer service team!

best clothing rental service in the game!!!. I discovered BNTO last year and it has really changed my style for the better. They carry some of my favorite brands - frankie’s bikinis, geel, peachy den + other awesome designers that I was able to try out and now love. This is the perfect subscription for someone who loves high quality pieces and switching up their style every month. They are constantly adding new clothing and the styling is on point. You can even purchase an item from your bnto box if you fall in love with it! Love love LOVE bnto!!!

A great rental app!. I have been really enjoying BNTO & the ease of using the app. The search engine has improved a lot since over the past several months and the new ai feature is super helpful for finding styles similar to items I like. I love that you get monthly credits that can be used towards future purchases or item upgrades as well!
The BEST. BNTO is my favorite fashion rental platform BY FAR. Love love love it and highly recommend.
LOVE!. amazing fits.
Love. They’ve added new brands since I was last a member and the options are really good!
Rent. I love all the new brands BNTO is introducing me too.

Truly the best clothing rental option!. I’ve been using BNTO for 5+ months now and I can truly say it’s changed the game for renting clothes. You can actually find unique pieces, high quality brands, statement pieces, brands you may have never heard of, and SO much more. There’s truly something for everyone and I’ve had such good luck reading reviews to figure out sizes to order or how things fit! Every item I’ve rented has come exactly how I expected, they ship everything so fast and make it so easy to return, + I feel like it’s more affordable than other options out there! The app is also extremely user friendly, so easy to navigate and save items, they even have a feature that helps curate pieces for you! Highly recommend for those that want unique expensive finds without committing to buying them full price or only wearing it once! The best part is you CAN purchase items that you love and you get a credit for every month you rent that you can use for a later purchase. Truly the best experience I’ve hard for renting clothes!
Nothing is ever available. Clothes are cute and not run through but nothing is ever in stock

Coolest Brands. By far the rental box with the coolest and most unique brands. Because I’ve been using BNTO so much, i’ve actually cleared out so much of my closet. I keep my closet to everyday basics and use BNTO for when I have plans or events. It makes life so much easier because half the time it takes for me to get ready is spent on trying to figure out an outfit. I also love the credit system to eventually save up to keep a piece! The only qualm I have is I wish things like accessories (scarfs, leg warmers, earrings, belts) didn’t count as a full rental piece. I don’t feel like I get much bang for my buck there. I also wish the “new arrivals” section was organized a bit better as sometimes it glitches.

10/10 service and subscription price. I’ve tried a few different clothing rental apps, and BNTO has easily been my favorite. I love the style of the clothing. They feature a lot of independent and emerging brands that I’ve followed for a while and now I get to try them out via BNTO. The subscription price feels fair for what you get, and I really appreciate the $20 monthly credit you can use toward purchases. That perk alone makes it stand out. Great app and great service overall.
Love!!!. Love BNTO. They have such cool and unique pieces.

Love BNTO!. I think this app is great for renting things although sometimes the items i want aren’t available but, there are plenty of other cool brands to rent from. This is a great place to discover cool new and up coming brands and get exposure to spicing up your wardrobe without the commitment of shopping and wasting money. I am a person who constantly changes my style up so having the opportunity to rent and give back is great <3
Love it!. I can always find very unique, trendy pieces that I know I won’t necessarily keep in my closet forever if I purchased them myself. I always get compliments on my BNTO items!

hope they fix the issues soon!. I’ve been a subscriber since launch, and while the app used to be fantastic, it’s gone downhill as it’s grown. Almost nothing in season is ever available, and anything decent like most of their coats are extra $$$ on top of the subscription. Also, there are frequent bugs like filters don’t work correctly, and unavailable items are often shown as available. It’s frustrating and makes the app feel like it’s being run more by AI than by actual inventory accuracy.

You can look, but you can’t touch….because nothing you like is actually available.. I used Nuuly last month, but BNTO is more my vibe and wanted to give both a try. Spent tons of time picking out a bunch of cool stuff, but out of probably 150+ different items I saved to capsules from a multitude of brands, maybe 20 were actually available to rent in my size (M/L) and all random stuff - like I’m not going to rent 4 pairs of jeans that all look the same and a bag for $100. I’ve been sitting on this app for months, convincing myself it was worth the money. And I am inundated with your ads on social media daily. So, I was disappointed to not be able to rent something I liked, especially when I had just saved so many options. I know you are moving warehouses so my hope is that you have plans for a big inventory increase. And kudos because the shortage issue is likely due to growing popularity and that’s an awesome problem to have. However, I can only assume that a lot of potential subscribers are experiencing the same and taking their money to Nuuly, which is a bummer because your clothes are 100x better 😢

Stick with Nuuly. I switched to BNTO after seeing the brands and styles they offered. It was great for a few months in early 2025, but now I haven't fulfilled an order in 2 months because everything that looks remotely warm has been out of stock every single time I check the app. Not to mention the app is a terrible user experience. I'll be canceling my subscription
Makes box maintenance a breeze. I found using push notifications super helpful in reminding myself when my due dates were and it’s helped me curate my wishlist in advance

The ultimate gift!. Stumbled upon this platform while shopping for gifts and it was such a pleasant surprise. I love a good fashion retailer like SSENSE and BNTO’s shopping experience was much better than that! I love the subscription based model they have and the wide range of clothes.. like sooo many cool clothes to rent it’s literally a steal LOL. Shipping was quick and will fursure get another box next month!
Love!. Love this app - bnto is great

Loving all the new features. Loving all the brands you can rent and the shopping experience is much smoother! You can now buy new which is great and organizing your wishlist into different capsules makes it easy to go back and select what’s available when actually building my box!
Best in Rental. Use this subscription if you’re looking for new/different brands. Found so many cool brands on this app!
functional but buggy. works well, hard to find my current bnto box and sort of buggy

Garbage. Couldn’t recommend something less. Nothing ever in stock, they sent me the wrong items, nicer items are an extra charge to rent- and these extra charges are high. I’m talking an extra $100+. Completely defeats the purpose of renting. Overall garbage. Was disappointed bc the selection looked great in the ads I was fed. Nuuly and RTR are both 1000x better
To die for. The assortment adds spice to my staple closet. Will do again & again😌

Good but slow. Sometimes I notice freezing, glitching and a general lag. When searching within categories a lot of products are also left out. I.e when searching for dresses they’re more formal while there are a lot of everyday and casual dresses
My absolute fav rental program. The new AI feature is super helpful for discovering products — I love how it also suggests full looks.
The Ai function is possessed. Legit pops up every two seconds I just want to scroll and see clothes like leave me alone

Love the selection, shipping is slow. Love the clothes and selection. The AI agent is a bit wonky and its results aren’t the best but I like how there is an option to still use normal search But my biggest gripe is the shipping time. I miss FashionPass / rent the runway shipping like sometimes it takes a week between dropping off the order and delivery so a month rental is more like a 3 week rental. Not the end of the world especially because the price is quite good but a bit annoying and pre planning / buffed is def needed if you want to rent for events.

Love the service, dislike the app. I’m a little ridiculous and use 3 subscription services - Nuuly, RTR, and now BNTO - and this app is by far the worst of them (but the best clothes!!!). The filters are very limited, sorting by “newest” never seems to work correctly, and when there is a review with a picture, you have to click into the review to see all the other reviews. For BNTO’s premium cost, the app is really lacking :(
Great service, app is weird. Some photos, especially those attached to reviews, do not show up. Can’t see the items…
Best of the rental services. I’m finding myself wearing my pieces much more than with rent the runway, armoire or nuuly (I’ve been trying them all!). Love the style and quality.

Almost there. The app is missing a few features to make it great. Longer authentication so I don’t have to log in constantly, better filters to show items that are available in my size from my wishlist, and a better UI for understanding when in need to return items.
I love BNTO. Such an amazing selection of items to rent. Very on trend, quality pieces.
Mediocre at best. Overall app functionality is lacks finesse to make it seamless to use.
An exercise in frustration. Be prepared for all of the items you’d like to rent to be unavailable.

Medium good.. I’ve tried most of these rental programs and this one is medium. The app is a little weird because you’ll have to toggle which clothes are actually in stock as well as in your size, which wasn’t much for me. From a handful of items I picked my most favorite, but nothing I would necessarily have been excited about from the get-go. Also, this is a USPS based package program. If you’ve used other services they might offer pharmacy or UPS pickup and drop off, for this service you will need to take your package to a US postal office in order to return it. Until the selection and ease of browsing improves you should check out similar rental apps at the same price point.

BNTO = A+ subscription box. I am a sucker for these subscriptions - I love finding new brands and this is a great way - let me Say, I think BNTO has the best box out there right now for women's apparel & some accessories (bags are dynamite) gives Nuuly a run for its money and is like awarding bonus credits to use to purchase the items and they have a nice price range , a lot is ~$150-$200 but quality is great and customer service is great too. BNTO - try to keep things consistent - you have a great program right now with unlimited length of time to keep rental, under $100 a mo. And we get a lot $$ money back as shoppable credits. I really love This program !

Glitchy. When I scroll my wishlist, click on an item, and go back, the wishlist jumps back to the beginning of the list, not where I left off. Also, when I switch on “available now” it doesn’t change anything on my wishlist availability.

So Worth It!. The BNTO app has a great selection of products from so many cool brands you don’t normally see on other platforms. I was able to try out a few brands I’ve never tried before without breaking the bank. It’s the ultimate try-on haul. They also have curated collections for different occasions and an AI chat that helps you look for specific types of items. Definitely a returning customer!!

Loving my BNTO experience!. I recently started using the BNTO app and it’s a game changer for anyone who loves fashion but wants to be more sustainable. It’s perfect for me because I love to mix and match outfits and now without the closet clutter. I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the clothes. Each item I received was in excellent condition and I love the variety. The selection feels fresh and current!
Love the service hate the app. Trying to login and it says successful, but then prompts me to login again. So frustrating since I’m having an issue with my order and am trying to resolve.
Service is good, app is buggy. Experiencing lots of issues with the app not loading on my iPad. I deleted and installed twice. Hoping I can resolve and place my shipment for this month.

Total waste. I was so excited to use this service again I have used it in the past . After my first month I was locked out of my account saying I needed to reset my password ( even though I knew my password ) . Countless emails trying to reset it so I could cancel it since I wasn’t able to utilize it being locked out I finally get ahold of someone and they cancel it for the next month but still charged me another month . The only solution was to delete the app bc it wouldn’t reset my password while it was downloaded to my phone . No refund and paid a full month for no service . Definitely wouldn’t use this again until the work out the kinks .

Login issues. While I love the service, the app itself feels glitchy. I paused my subscription just now and it requested three unique logins (each with a passkey) in order to complete this task and send back my current products. I have given other feedback via email. As a PM I would say this should be a priority to continue to maintain such a great service!

Luck of the Draw. I’ve been a member for years but recently I’m frustrated at the lack of available hearted or favorite items. I have multiple favorites lists with zero available items or only items that are a year or TWO old!
app sucks. logs me out at least once a month. makes me fill out the same prompts every time I open the app - name/birthday/style inspo blah blah blah. annoying as hell.

Excellent Customer Service. I rented on and off with RTR, even purchased a dress with them. I ultimately decided to close my account when I didn’t find enough options in my very eclectic style to justify the subscription. They have many stylish options but they just weren’t ‘me’. That said, I cancelled my subscription before sending off my rentals and my spouse offered to drop them off while out on errands. Unfortunately, he forgot them and they stayed in his trunk for two months! I understandably received a large withdrawal from my bank account and was shocked. I reached out to customer support and immediately resolved the charges upon their return. Later, the shipping facility missed a scan of one of the returns and customer service reached out again to confirm it was sent, I confirmed and they issued that refund as well. Their customer service was responsive, proactive and helpful. I plan to rent again with them as needed for special occasion gowns. Great company.
Desktop version is better. The app glitches a ton. Even when signing in. If you’re going to use this app monthly like I do, just know you’ll likely want to be on your desktop.

deceptive review practices. I’ve been with RTR for a really really long time (10 years?), but the customer service is very spotty. They have deceptive coupons when you try to pause your membership, and once you confirm to unpause your membership, then they will tell you you can’t use the coupon they just offered you. They reject any reviews that are remotely negative (I mentioned that a fabric was polyester and they rejected the review!), which is really unhelpful and deceptive. Their inventory is tiny - it is exceedly rare that an item I like will be available for me to rent.
Add fav Designers list. Please add an option to heart favorite designers and see newest arrivals from favorite designers.

Censor in-app feedback about clothing items. RTR only allows positive feedback on the app for clothing. I’ve received several items with poor fabric quality (holes, haphazard sewing) and they have declined to publish the review. This seems in violation of the FTC which does not allow selectively allowing only positive reviews. Just be aware that on the app it is not possible to get honest feedback on the items you’re renting

Not reliable. Terrible company. I ordered 2 dresses months ago for a wedding and they contacted me today saying one of the dresses isn’t available and I need to choose another or my order won’t ship. From Luxury Convenience to Constant Disappointment — A Loyal Customer’s Honest Review. I’ve been a Rent the Runway customer since 2019, with nearly 200 items rented, and it’s genuinely disappointing to say how far this service has fallen. What once felt like a luxury, reliable experience has slowly turned into frustration after frustration. I’ve received multiple damaged items that clearly should not have been in circulation. On top of that, reusable return bags are no longer consistently included, forcing customers to scramble just to return items properly—something that used to be seamless. Meanwhile, monthly prices continue to increase, yet the quality of service and product control has declined. The changes over the years have shifted the burden onto loyal customers while offering less value in return. I stayed with Rent the Runway for years because it worked. It felt sustainable, stylish, and dependable. Now it feels like cost-cutting at the expense of the very customers who helped build the brand. I truly hope leadership listens to long-time renters, because this platform used to be special—and right now, it’s losing the trust of those who supported it the longest.

Love the service, but the app could use improving. I have been a RTR customer for about two years now. I love the concept and the styles they offer! Just a few small updates to the app would make a world of difference in the user experience. Hopefully my review will be read and these suggestions are taken into consideration! 1) Move previously rented styles to their own “Hearts List.” This would allow me to easily see all of my past rentals. Currently, there’s no way to see past rentals unless the items have been liked. The problem with that is when I’m looking for new styles to rent, the boards with styles I’ve hearted are full of clothes I’ve already rented. But I don’t want to remove them from my likes, because I have rented things more than once and want to be able to access those styles again. I wish there was a way to filter those options out without having to remove them from your likes entirely. 2) Sometimes I browse on my phone, sometimes I’m looking on my iPad, and other times I’m using the web browser on my laptop. What’s in your cart does not carry over between devices, making it super frustrating if you have to switch mid-search for whatever reason. Unsure why there is no continuity there. If it’s my account, my cart should show what’s in it regardless of where I’m accessing it. 3) The app crashes, sometimes when I’m suuuper deep in my search. It’s impossible to get back to. 4) Improved search functionality (SEO), please! This app would be truly AMAZING if the items were tagged better and searching yielded more results. Half the time items I KNOW are on the app don’t even pop up—and that’s using simple keywords like “shirt.” I wish I could try searching “colorful birthday looks,” for example. There’s so much room for opportunity here! Thanks for reading!

They have a “good fit” algorithm, but I find it to be wildly inaccurate. You would think that RTR would let you swap out anything that doesn’t fit, but that is not the case. Snake Oil Subscription Service. Be warned!! RTR has become subjected to the same snake oil, subscription service as every other company. Here’s how: (1) Price Gauging. In the subscription, you cannot rent all items that would be available if you were to select renting for a single date. Why? I have yet to figure out. Inventory, is inventory. ALSO all 4 items have to be available at the same time!! You also cannot pick two you really wanted one week then two others later. It make the pickings extremely low. Doesn’t matter if you haven’t rented anything in the past two months and all parties can see that. (4) Nonnegotiable terms. If unable to refund my card, I asked if I could have credited to my account to purchase items sold. HARD NO, which clearly means they don’t even care about customers just that they “cheated you out of the fine print”. Have I made mistakes in subscription services before? Yes, I’m a busy working woman (hence the RTR appeal). It happened with Audible & Just Fab. But both of those companies refund policies where money was spent but services clearly NOT used, actually has me open to using them again in the future. NOT RTR & you shouldn’t waste your money or time either. Take your $1800/year and support your local boutiques.
